description: Canonical skill-lint profile fixtures (spec A4). Each row pins one classification decision and its expected violation codes. `skillId` is the resolved target directory basename — the identity source at CLI and dsh configured skill-root boundaries — never the doc's YAML `name` alone. Expected columns: `expectedKind` (core|runtime|authoring), `expectedMode` (runtime|authoring|null; null = five-question skipped, core exemption only), `expectedFiveQuestionCodes` (exact violation codes; null = check skipped, [] = ran and passed), `expectedFrontmatterCodes` (exact codes; the frontmatter check stays active in every row). Rows are consumed by the Engine, CLI and dsh tests; the profile policy lives only in packages/engine/src/skill-authoring.ts (classifySkillLint).
